additional_info.subject: Note to ES team
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
NA
Problem Description:
The issue is Power convertor Error Flag F2, E52-
Fast Shutdown Not Performed
.
2102312VGQKXP6000644SA002200000200FW:DC118PF118H100,F:2,E52
RC replaced one of the converter with an Error, and after 12 hours, the issue reoccurred on other convertor.
Action Performed (L2):
A hard reboot was performed, but the issue persists. The shared KA related to the ‘fast shutdown was not performed', but RC suspects there is another issue with the converter error and suggests checking with the expert.
Charger SW Version:
v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
Deeper analysis
Fault history:
Initially, an F2, E52 converter error was found on one power converter. RC checked all the cabling and swapped the converter. After swapping, the issue reoccurred on the same converter, so RC replaced the converter.
Action Required
by HQ:
Needs to check if there are any other issues for the F2, E52 converter error.
